scope_issues: The scenario involves multiple donors making monthly direct debit payments and one-off donations beyond Elaine Carter's transaction. Each of those transactions would need individual assessment against all atoms; this evaluation covers only FP-0316-EL.
The tax-year cumulative condition in a3 has been assessed only for Elaine Carter's donations in 2025–26; other donors' tax positions are not evidenced and cannot be assessed here.
